ActionStep_Input.title: ActionStep
ActionStep_Input.description:
Call a registered connector action and continue with its structured output.

A write action needs exactly one authorization: ``approval_step`` names a human step
on every path to this one whose approval leads here, or ``standing_write`` records the
definer's standing permission. Read-only actions take neither. A failed or unknown
result never continues on a business branch.

CreateRoutineRequest.title: CreateRoutineRequest
CreateRoutineRequest.description:
Schedule a workflow at a fixed interval.

Without workflow_definition_id the routine runs life.review v1, with no external or
model side effects, and a past time triggers a single coalesced review when the host
next ticks. With it, the routine starts that exact custom workflow revision with
``inputs``; a new occurrence is skipped while the previous Run still waits, and
missed_run_policy (required) says whether a late occurrence runs once ("run_once") or is
skipped when more than 60 seconds late ("skip"). next_due_at must include a timezone
offset. enabled=false persists the routine without scheduling it.

HumanStep_Input.description:

``timeout_seconds`` and ``on_timeout`` go together; without them the step waits until
decided.

LifeRoutine.title: LifeRoutine
LifeRoutine.description:
``workflow`` is "custom" when the routine is bound to a custom workflow revision;
``workflow_version`` is then that revision.

RefValue.title: RefValue
RefValue.description: The value at a path in the Run inputs or in an earlier step's output.

SaveWorkflowDefinitionRequest.title: SaveWorkflowDefinitionRequest
SaveWorkflowDefinitionRequest.description:
Save the next immutable revision of ``name`` in this project.

``expected_revision`` is null for a new name, otherwise the latest saved revision.

StartWorkflowRequest.title: StartWorkflowRequest
StartWorkflowRequest.description:
Capture needs source_text and tasks; review reads this project and accepts neither.

Confirmation applies only to capture. Omitting it means true; false explicitly creates
the provided tasks immediately. Neither workflow executes the described life tasks.

TemplateValue.title: TemplateValue
TemplateValue.description: Text with ``{path}`` placeholders, each a reference rendered as text.

UpdateLifeTaskRequest.title: UpdateLifeTaskRequest
UpdateLifeTaskRequest.description: Complete replacement of task-editable fields; null explicitly clears due_at.

UpdateRoutineRequest.title: UpdateRoutineRequest
UpdateRoutineRequest.description: Replace scheduling fields; completed runs retain their original schedule snapshot.
